verdict.rationale: Factory documents planning plain-language intent into scoped work: Missions has Droid define features, milestones, and success criteria before any code is written. Linear and Jira issues can also be assigned to Factory for Droid to investigate, implement, and test. However, the docs do not show a plain-language description being automatically converted into a discrete, scoped implementation task artifact; planning appears collaborative rather than automatic. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic intent-to-task scoping output (e.g., a generated task spec with scope boundaries), detail on how bug reports are decomposed, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can describe a feature or bug in plain language and have it automatically turned into a scoped implementation task

citations.quote: Work with Droid to define features, milestones, and success criteria before any code is written.
Assign a Linear issue to Factory or mention `@Factory` in an issue comment to have Droid investigate, implement, and test the work.
Droid analyzes your codebase, proposes changes, and shows what will be modified before applying anything.
